subcategory_text: System or device configurations permit selective collection or disclosure of data elements.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CM-7 (Least Functionality), AC-3
implementation_examples: Design system or device configurations to permit selective collection or disclosure of data elements (e.g., granular privacy controls, opt-in/opt-out granularity)
Expose configuration affordances to users at the same level of granularity as the data model
Document the configuration surface and validate that it operates as designed
assessment_objectives: Determine whether configurations permit selective collection or disclosure
Determine whether the configuration surface matches the data-model granularity
Determine whether configuration changes are observable to the user
